title: Standard Condenser Kit W/ Walnut Spinning Mouthpiece
description:
The Standard Condenser Kit comes with a titanium standard condenser tube, a dark walnut wood spinning mouthpiece and all the O-rings needed to install your Standard condenser kit.
The standard size is compatible with all 45mm midsections. It is NOT compatible with an M. If looking to add a condenser and spinning mouthpiece to your M you will need the XL size.
Standard Condenser Kit W/ Walnut Spinning Mouthpiece comes with the following.
1 x Titanium Standard Condenser Tube
3 x Condenser O-Rings
1 x Walnut Spinning Mouthpiece
